text: Published checked v1 identities/digests shall not be silently amended. Checked v2 shall select the stronger execution digest/runtime, preserve built-in fault IDs 1–13, add ID 14 for `uninitialized_read` and 15 for `data_race`, and retain user-ID base 65536. Exact-component linking shall reject old v1-bound objects in a v2 program.
